In Git v3, and Git v2 if compiled with WITH_BREAKING_CHANGES=1, some of the default Git config options are changing in ways that the upstream git-lfs test suite can't (yet) handle. To avoid that causing failures, explicitly set the Git config to match the Git v2 defaults, so the tests will continue to pass with both the current Git behaviour and the with the breaking changes enabled.

Fixes #571745.

items.content_html:
Since nixpkgs has a mix of packages referring to git, and others to
gitMinimal, it's common to end up with both in your system closure,
growing the closure by another 110 MiB each time.

This series of patches re-organizes the package construction to make
gitMinimal one of the outputs of git. With that change, both can be installed
side-by-side and not cause any duplicates in the system closure.

To remove the references to the docs, I had to add a small patch to git for it
to lookup the doc in $XDG_DATA_DIRS.

paths closure git's own outputs
Before
git (out, which refers to doc) 88 388.7 MiB 56.5 MiB
gitMinimal 34 161.6 MiB 54.0 MiB
git + gitMinimal 89 442.7 MiB 110.5 MiB
After
git.bin = gitMinimal = "${git}" 31 151.4 MiB 55.1 MiB
git.out 88 373.1 MiB 1.4 MiB
git as installed (out + doc) 89 388.7 MiB 17.0 MiB
git + gitMinimal 89 388.7 MiB 72.1 MiB

items.content_html:
The release tarball that Nixpkgs uses to build Git includes a pre-generated configure file which isn't committed to the Git source code repositories themselves. Passing the path to curl-config using a configure flag only works when that pre-generated configure file already exists.

Instead of setting the path to curl-config with a slightly obscure configure flag, include it in nativeBuildInputs so it gets picked up both by Nixpkgs' builds using release tarballs, and also in circumstances where src refers a source that doesn't include the pre-generated configure file. This allows downstream users to override the Nixpkgs git package to reference, say, the tip of upstream Git's "next" branch.

This commit is cherry-picked from an unmerged commit that was originally included in #567961.

items.title: nixos/bash/git-ps1: init

items.content_html:
git on Darwin read its system config only from its own store path, so /etc/gitconfig and /etc/gitattributes had no effect.

The keychain default stays in $out/etc/gitconfig and includes /etc/gitconfig so the config can override it, as proposed by Apple for distributor defaults: https://lore.kernel.org/git/63687F17-1BC5-40B4-9708-EACFFEEFCB57@apple.com/

This changes nothing on Linux, since the git package ships no default settings. On Darwin, git now correctly reads /etc.

Fixes: #93784
